USDT.method: Hourly historical USD observations aggregated by UTC date; close=last observation; min/max are sampled hourly points, not exchange OHLC; missing dates blank; no interpolation

notes: Input files are read in place and are never copied, moved, or modified.
Price series are daily aggregates of hourly historical observations; sampled min/max are not exchange OHLC.
Macro event overlap is contextual annotation and does not establish causality.
No missing prices are interpolated by this script.
